prop.lock:
STYLE LOCK — KOTTU PHOTO-STICKER (use exactly this for every prop)
Subject: ONE real-world object, isolated, described in the item line.
Rendering: a premium die-cut PHOTO sticker. A crisp studio product photograph of the real object — true
materials, real textures, accurate proportions — cut out cleanly along its silhouette, with a continuous,
even, pure white (#FFFFFF) border about 3% of the image width all the way around the object, and a thin
dark aubergine (#1B1530) keyline (about 0.5% of the width) around the outside of the white border.
Lighting: soft studio key light from the top-left, gentle fill from the right, no harsh specular
hotspots. The whole object is in sharp focus; no depth-of-field blur.
Camera: three-quarter view from slightly above (about 25 degrees above the object's horizon), object
turned about 20 degrees to the left, like a toy sitting on a desk.
Colour: natural materials; painted or plastic parts pushed toward this street palette where the object
allows it: tuk-tuk yellow #FFC93C, temple red #E8453C, peacock teal #0FA3A3, lotus pink #FF7EB6,
thambili orange #FF8A3D, leaf green #3DBE6B.
Composition: the object is centred and fills about 80% of a square canvas; the whole object and its
white border are visible; nothing is cropped.
Background: fully transparent (PNG with alpha). If transparency is not available, use a perfectly flat,
uniform pure magenta (#FF00FF) background with no gradient, no vignette and no texture.
Text: none. No letters, numbers, labels, logos or brand names anywhere on the object or the image.
Never: cast shadow, contact shadow, reflection, ground plane, table, background props, scenery, people,
hands, watermarks, signatures, frames, or any border other than the die-cut border.
Output: 1024 x 1024 PNG.

sticker.lock:
STYLE LOCK — KOTTU MASCOT STICKER (use exactly this for every sticker)
Subject: ONE cartoon mascot, isolated, described in the item line.
Rendering: a die-cut vinyl sticker. Flat 2D vector-style cartoon illustration with bold, uniform dark
aubergine (#1B1530) outlines (about 2.5% of the image width for the silhouette, about 1.5% for inner
details). Flat saturated fills from this palette only: tuk-tuk yellow #FFC93C, temple red #E8453C,
peacock teal #0FA3A3, lotus pink #FF7EB6, thambili orange #FF8A3D, leaf green #3DBE6B, plus cream
#FFF7E8, white and aubergine #1B1530.
Shading: exactly one hard-edged cel-shadow tone per colour (a darker shade of the same hue) and one small
white gloss highlight. No gradients, no airbrush, no texture, no noise.
Character: friendly and a little mischievous; big round eyes with white catchlights and an open happy
smile when the subject has a face; chunky rounded proportions; a dynamic pose with a slight tilt.
Sri Lankan details are drawn from real life and treated with respect.
Die-cut: a thick, continuous pure white (#FFFFFF) border about 5% of the image width around the whole
silhouette (small parts join the main shape inside the white border), then a thin aubergine (#1B1530)
keyline around the outside of the white border.
Composition: centred; the sticker fills about 82% of a square canvas; nothing is cropped.
Background: fully transparent (PNG with alpha). If transparency is not available, use a perfectly flat
pure magenta (#FF00FF) background with no gradient.
Text: none. No letters, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere.
Never: drop shadow, glow, background scenery, photographic rendering, 3D render look, watermarks,
signatures.
Output: 1024 x 1024 PNG.

badge.lock:
STYLE LOCK — KOTTU INLINE BADGE (use exactly this for every badge)
Identical to KOTTU MASCOT STICKER, simplified for a 48-pixel display: ONE simple object; at most four
flat colours plus the outline; very thick outlines (about 4% of the image width); no small details; no
face unless the item line asks for one; white die-cut border about 6% of the width with the aubergine
keyline. Transparent background (or flat pure magenta #FF00FF). No text. Output: 1024 x 1024 PNG.

assets.subject: A die-cast toy model of a classic Sri Lankan three-wheeler tuk-tuk (auto-rickshaw) with exactly three wheels: glossy tuk-tuk yellow body, a temple red stripe along the side, a peacock teal canvas roof, chrome trim, black tyres, front three-quarter view. Number plate blank.

A black business laptop with a red pointing-stick nub in the middle of the keyboard, lid open at 110 degrees. The screen shows a dark aubergine terminal with neat rows of colourful text-like bars (pink, yellow, green) and, on the left, an abstract blue triangle made of text characters. No readable words, no logos.
A souvenir miniature model of Colombo's Lotus Tower: a slim white tower with teal bands, topped by a large lotus bud in pink and leaf green, standing on a small round teal base.

A real willow cricket bat lying horizontally, with a lotus pink striped rubber grip on the handle, and a red leather cricket ball with a white seam resting against the bottom of the blade. No stickers or text on the bat.

assets.subject: A whole king coconut (thambili) with bright orange husk, the top sliced open showing cream flesh, a red-and-white striped paper straw standing in it, and one small green leaf tied at the base.
A cup of Ceylon tea in a temple red enamel cup with a white rim, on a matching saucer, a small silver teaspoon on the saucer, gentle white steam curling above. Tea is amber-brown.

A vintage peacock teal transistor radio with a cream round speaker grille, a tuk-tuk yellow tuning window with a red needle (no numbers on the dial), two lotus pink knobs, a chrome carry handle and an extended antenna.

A traditional Sri Lankan Vesak lantern (vesak kooduwa): an eight-pointed paper star lantern in tuk-tuk yellow, lotus pink and peacock teal paper panels on a thin bamboo frame, with long temple red paper tassels hanging from the bottom points and a short string loop at the top.
